title: Complete playtest history: dated proof, superseded gaps and current evidence boundaries
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

ids: October1–22 dated release/source/browser/persistence/performance audits; native file/chest followthrough; reference/choices/world/absorption receipts
reviews.classification: chronological execution and verification evidence owner; preserve history and scope current claims
reviews.disposition:
Full-content review covers the 660 pre-fold lines, including the combined October22 release pointer, October5 source-only deliveries, October1–4 foundation/actor/UI/transaction proofs and source audits, October6 reference wave, October7 four-game absorption, October9 choices/optional-world slices and October11 absorption A–E/combined receipts. Preserve these chronological entries, fingerprints, failed attempts, corrections and explicit limits as history.

**Current evidence routing.** “Latest combined” means the dated October22 receipt, not a November5 installed release. [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md) owns current focus; [architecture rules](ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md), [UI rules](UI_RULES.md) and the actual delivery's acceptance backlog own its current seam and checks. A historical source fingerprint, rebuilt bundle, test count, static HTTP response, import/registry check, packaged app and exercised behavior establish different things. Source-only Frontier/Glasshouse/skills/reference deliveries remain implemented-unverified in their recorded scopes. Their implementation-first test deferrals were specific instructions for those waves, not a standing exemption for later changed inputs. AD36/AD43 govern current work; AD42 makes human review optional rather than a technical blocker. Retired one-world/one-prestige ordering is historical, not a revived project gate.

**Read later receipts before carrying old gaps forward.** The early export dialog timeout and generated-file-only checks are followed by actual native downloaded-file roundtrips and v0.6 fidelity/rejection proofs. The visitor profile's then-unconverted chest is followed by native chest transactions, imports, injected failures and the final spare-equipment correction. The earlier key-wide equipment block was corrected to allow an actual owned spare without transferring the worn unit; the independent source review predates that policy correction. Notebook/menu/body/People entries likewise supersede selected earlier UI placements, not every historical limitation. Keep the earlier failures because they explain what the later evidence actually closed. No equivalent November5 regression is inferred from either date.

**Fixture reachability differs from natural progression.** Generated high skills, unlocked access, supplied materials, strong heroes, seeded encounters and funded review files can exercise real native actions, costs, outputs, clock, persistence and rejection paths without proving natural acquisition, whole-campaign pacing or every branch. Native Save/reload, encoded file import and actual Export/download/reimport have distinct recorded scopes. Unknown-reference rejection, exact durable bytes under injected quota failures, one-writer behavior, frozen outcomes and lawful custody are valuable bounded invariants, not universal compatibility or full gameplay. Body discovery, directed NPC recognition and visible reports remain separate from private source ancestry, frozen hidden outcomes and omniscient actor knowledge. Preserve sealed routes without disclosing their truth here.

**Performance has an input and a boundary.** The fresh/visitor/64-helper samples, three-fighter browser run, pure scheduler benchmarks and isolated combat probes measure their stated populations and environments. Returning 9488 unspent minutes from a 10000-minute request at the 512-boundary cap is not a completed catch-up. The later scheduler comparison preserves exact plans and real ownership while improving those samples; its crowded active tick still exceeded a frame budget. Short idle frame samples, stable listener counts and bounded post-GC heap observations do not establish sustained active60fps, indefinite leak freedom or a whole-world population result. Browser-closed progress, native world bindings and new persistence backends are not implied. Historical local URLs, open tabs and process statements are dated evidence, not current live handles.

**Corrections and warnings retain their proper cause.** Preserve server queue/connection resets, ambiguous selectors, stale inventory attributes, wrong expected combat damage, invalid fixture fields and genuine adapter repairs separately. Do not suppress an ancillary request warning or convert a harness launch timeout into an established application defect. Source audits' extracted/inert-function counterexamples support their exact mismatch, not ordinary browser reachability or a newly reproduced current bug. The four-game proof explicitly retains its final warning-assertion exit and later focused followthrough; bounded leaf checks are not a full regression. Later Village choices distinguish accelerated common ticks from the separately exercised ordinary timer. October11 individual and combined absorption receipts name actual native outputs, identities, condition, save/import and frozen options; their earlier test totals and matched source maps remain bound to those builds.

**Reopen by consumer and changed input.** For a concrete current claim, use the linked delivery report/receipt and its acceptance backlog, identify the actual source/bundle/fixture and rerun only the applicable current checks. Keep positive, negative, persistence and player-choice evidence distinct. No broad engine, source-world, natural playthrough, installation or human acceptance claim follows from this log review. This reconciliation changed documentation only; no historical script, source probe, gameplay, test/build/browser, installed app or private save was newly exercised.
